choices: A. Escalate to the Program governance board.
B. Write a recommendation to close that project.

text: Which of the following options contain the direction of the program?
choices: A. Program management plan and roadmap.

text: Your organization had been awarded a construction of a new industrial city. You are the program manager of this program. choices: A. Explain to them that the closure conditions of the component are met.

text: You are a program manager of HYC program. Within the above context, which of the following is not included in program transition?
choices: D. Transition from as-is to to-be.

text: DSDS is a large organization in the production of steel. They want to increase the productivity by the construction of a new factory. Now you are in a meeting with the portfolio manager discussing the framework in which the portfolio, program and projects management are integrated to achieve the strategic objectives. Which one of the following options can provide the mentioned above framework?

Your organization just awarded the construction of a new seaport. During the portfolio meeting, some of the members prefer to pursuit it as a project, while other members suggest to pursuit it as program to enhance the delivery of benefits. How can the program enhance the delivery of benefits?
choices: A. By ensuring that the strategies and work plans of the program are responsively adapted to changes in the direction or strategies of the sponsoring organization.
B. By ensuring that the strategies and work plans of program components are responsively adapted to component outcomes, or to changes in the direction of the sponsoring organization.

choices: A. You, because you are the program manager.

text: You are a program manager of the construction of a new hospital. During the execution of the program, you have identified a delay in getting resources allocated to the program components. Within the above context, what is your action?
choices: A. Escalate the matter to the program sponsor.
